title: How To Make A Landing Page For Member Sign-Ups
text:
## How To Make A Landing Page For Member Sign-Ups
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000037629
Creating a landing page has never been easier! Using the Pre-Made Elements on statics pages allows admins and designers to create multiple signup pages.
Please follow the instructions below to learn how to create a landing page for member sign-ups that looks like this:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12092699054/original/w5gAj2e-aDnSXUIA1dxyJncjZA9mNDjuqQ.png?1621186075 | alt: ]
1. Open an existing static page or create a new one. For more information, see: How to Create a New Static Page .
2. Add a single row using the table option in the Froala Editor. Add background color and text as desired: Froala Editor .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181731152/original/2QEeNhCOMzgirvGHSpLg_C4h9emszVon7A.png?1783553189 | alt: ]
3. Drag and drop the pre-made element “Text With Image Left” into the static page, and add the text and image accordingly.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181731357/original/LcsiWZDJyNiMwgSAKzUP7tmY_8MIV8pAQg.png?1783553529 | alt: ]
4. Edit the button text and update the link to the desired destination page.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181731378/original/kflkjaXAfh6ywhrYm16xtYIloID9ClF0Tg.png?1783553566 | alt: ]
5. Click on save changes:
Take advantage of BD Butler , our built-in AI, to help you design this page.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181731380/original/y1hQBEdVsP81dL0LPVmgKrUjNxFHhhlb3w.png?1783553588 | alt: ]
